title: Converting a character and code point
description: You can follow A into its numeric code point and back.

steps.description: ord receives the character A. You store its Unicode code point in ascii_value; for this character it also matches the ASCII value.
The first print displays 65. You have converted the character into an integer.

steps.question: Which character does chr return for 65?
steps.answer: It returns A, reversing this example's ord conversion.

steps.description: You see A after 65 in the output. The two calls move between a character and its numeric code point.
